 Toy Robot Video brings Christmas treats of Wesley Snipes, Burt Reynolds and Kiss!!!
 Joe Corey 
 •
 November 10, 2026 
 Disc Announcements , News 
 Normally we get toy robots for Christmas, but this holiday season Toy Robot Video brings three perfect gifts on 4K UHD for under the tree. First is Passenger 57 that solidified Wesley Snipes as an action star. He’s stuck on a plane with the world’s most dangerous terrorists. He has to take them down before they kill everyone in business class. He uses every part of the plane to get an advantage. Next up is Sharky’s Machine starring and directed by the legend Burt Reynolds. After a screw up on a narcotics case, Sharky get truly booted into the basement of the police headquarters. He’s not on the pathetic vice squad. But Sharky ain’t going to lurk in parks looking for guys wanting a date. He ends up spying a high-class hooker who is servicing the future governor of Georgia. The film takes us around early ’80s Atlanta. It also features an amazing stunt featuring a guy smashing through a window and plummeting off a skyscraper. This is Burt Reynolds making a serious police thriller and not merely yuck it up with Henry Silva. Sharky’s Machine is so worth reviving on 4K UHD. Finally there’s Detroit Rock City about four teenagers eager to see Kiss in concert at Cobo Arena. This was the arena where Kiss’ legacy was minted and included on Alive! So you can see why Ed Furlong and his buddies are willing to go to extremes to get inside the sold-out show. Director Adam Rifkin not merely captured the times, but the urge for teenagers to embrace Gene, Ace, Paul and Peter. 
 Each release features the movie on both 4K UHD and Blu-ray. Here’s the press release from Toy Robot Video with all the details:
 Toy Robot Video Celebrates the Holiday Season  
 with an Action Classic, a Burt Reynolds Neo-Noir Thriller,  
 and KISS Rocking the Motor City  
 Passenger 57, Sharky’s Machine and Detroit Rock City
Make Their Worldwide 4K UHD Premieres this December    
 Passenger 57 
 [4K UHD] 
 12/8 
 Sharky’s Machine 
 [4K UHD] 
 12/8 
 Detroit Rock City 
 [4K UHD] 
 12/15 
 On December 8 , travelers will be betting on black when the blockbuster aviation thrill ride Passenger 57 lands on 4K UHD. Director Kevin Hooks ( Strictly Business ) takes audiences 35,000 feet into the air, where a violent hostage situation leaves one man standing between the passengers and a ruthless terrorist. This Dual Format release features both a 4K UHD and Blu-ray disc, with the film presented on both discs in a new 4K restoration from the original camera negative, along with special features.
 FBI agents transport dangerous terrorist Charles Rane ( Bruce Payne , Dungeons & Dragons ) from Miami to Los Angeles on an Atlantic International flight. His cold-blooded gang has a detailed plan to free him and hijack the airplane. They factored in everything except Passenger 57. John Cutter ( Wesley Snipes , Blade ) teaches anti-terrorism techniques to flight crews but now finds himself putting those lessons to the ultimate test. Along for the turbulent ride are Tom Sizemore ( Natural Born Killers ), Alex Datcher ( Jury Duty ), Bruce Greenwood ( Exotica ), Elizabeth Hurley ( Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery ) and Michael Horse ( Twin Peaks ).
 Special features include a new 4K scan of the original camera negative in a 4K (2160p) UHD Blu-ray presentation in Dolby Vision (HDR10 compatible); optional English subtitles for the deaf and hard of hearing; a brand-new interview with writer Stewart Raffill ; and a new 2K scan of the original theatrical trailer.

 Also on December 8 , the hard-edged, neo-noir thriller, Sharky’s Machine , makes its worldwide 4K UHD debut. Burt Reynolds directed and starred in this critically acclaimed vice squad blockbuster. The new Dual Format release features both a 4K UHD and Blu-ray disc, with the film presented on both discs in a new 4K scan and restoration from the original camera negative, along with special features.
 Sgt. Tom Sharky ( Burt Reynolds , Smokey and the Bandit ) gets demoted from narcotics to the vice squad in the Atlanta police headquarters’ basement. His new assignment finds him cruising parks and busting prostitutes and johns, a far cry from the high-stakes narcotics cases he’s accustomed to. Things get interesting when he begins wiretapping the high-class hookers working for the city’s most powerful pimp, uncovering phone calls between Dominoe ( Rachel Ward , Against All Odds ) and a candidate for governor ( Earl Holliman , Police Woman ). Sharky becomes increasingly obsessed with the seductive Dominoe while maintaining surveillance on her luxury apartment, but powerful forces on both sides of the law want his investigation shut down. Powering the all-star lineup are Charles Durning ( O Brother, Where Art Thou? ), Brian Keith ( The Parent Trap ), Bernie Casey ( Bill & Ted’s Excellent Adventure ) and Henry Silva ( Above the Law ).
 Special features include a new 4K scan of the original camera negative in a 4K (2160p) UHD Blu-ray presentation in Dolby Vision (HDR10 compatible); optional English subtitles for the deaf and hard of hearing; brand-new interviews with screenwriter Gerald Di Pego , actor/stuntman Dan Inosanto and actor Robert Duncan McNeill ; filmmaker Adam Rifkin ( Detroit Rock City ) remembering Burt Reynolds ; a new 2K scan of the theatrical trailer; teaser trailer; TV spot; and behind-the-scenes stills gallery.
 Watch the trailer for Sharky’s Machine here: 
 On December 15 , you wanted the best, you got the best when Detroit Rock City makes its
worldwide 4K UHD premiere! Director Adam Rifkin ( The Dark Backward ) delivers the ultimate rock ‘n’ roll road trip comedy, following four friends willing to do just about anything to see KISS live in concert. This Dual Format release features both a 4K UHD and Blu-ray disc, with the film presented on both discs, along with special features.
 Hawk ( Edward Furlong , Terminator 2: Judgment Day ), Trip ( James DeBello , American Pie ), Jam ( Sam Huntington , Not Another Teen Movie ) and Lex ( Giuseppe Andrews , Cabin Fever ) are high schoolers with their own KISS cover band and a mutual dream. The foursome has scored tickets to see the real KISS at a sold-out concert in Detroit, but one of their deeply religious mothers derails their chance to rock and roll all night and party every day. Refusing to miss their idols on stage, the boys embark on a wild journey, determined to make it to the show by any means necessary. Rocking out to the KISS soundtrack are Lin Shaye ( A Nightmare on Elm Street ), Melanie Lynskey ( Yellowjackets ), Natasha Lyonne ( Poker Face ), Shannon Tweed ( Gene Simmons Family Jewels ), Joe Flaherty ( SCTV ), and KISS .
 Special features include a new 4K scan of the original camera negative in a 4K (2160p) UHD Blu-ray presentation in Dolby Vision (HDR10 compatible); optional English subtitles for the deaf and hard of hearing; brand-new interviews with director Adam Rifkin , actress Lin Shaye and production designer Steve Hardie ; three audio commentaries with director Adam Rifkin , cast and crew, and KISS ; Miscellaneous S**t documentary; Look into the Sun featurette; Cutting Room Floor ; deleted scenes; two music videos; and the theatrical trailer.
